units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>מדו׳ בעניות</he> afflicted with poverty.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>עני מדו׳</he> a very poor man.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:2">Tosef. Sabb. VIII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:2">IX</cite>), 2; <cite ref="Shabbat 75b">Sabb. 75ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 97b">97ᵇ</cite> (v. Rashi a. l.).

senses.gloss: to examine minutely, search, investigate (charity cases); to trace genealogical records (corresp. to בָּדַק); in gen. to be very strict in religious observances; (with עם) to deal strictly with (esp. used of divine retribution).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 8:6:8">Y. Peah VIII, 21ᵃ</cite> <he>מְדַקְדְּקִין בכסות וכ׳</he> you must make inquiries if one asks for clothes, but you must not &c., if food is asked for; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 9a:6">B. Bath. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>בודקין</he>).—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:2:3">Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᵈ</cite> <he>אין מד׳ אחריה</he> you must not trace its past records. Y. B. Bath. IV, end, 14ᵈ it is the custom in sales <he>להיות מְדַקְדְּקִין</he> to be strict, opp. <he>בעין יפה</he> liberal.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:15">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> <he>מד׳ עמהם</he> he is stinting (illiberal) towards the poor. Y. Succ. I, 52ᵇ top <he>לא די׳ בה</he> he paid no particular attention to its preparation.
<cite ref="Chullin 4a:13">Ḥull. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>הרבה מד׳ בה יותר וכ׳</he> they are very strict in the observance, even more so than &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 1">Tosef. Pes. I (II), 15</cite>.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 121b:8">Yeb. 121ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 50:3">Ps. L, 3</cite>) <he>הקב״ה מד׳ עם וכ׳</he> the Lord deals with those around Him (the good) strictly, to a hair’s breadth; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:12">Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27">Lev. R. s. 27</cite>; a. fr.—Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 11">Mishp. 11</cite> <he>למה אתה תְדַקְדֵּק בהכאתה</he> why art thou so severe in punishing her?
